label.en: AI Full-Stack Engineer · LLM Agent / RAG · React · FastAPI
label.zh: AI 全栈工程师 · LLM Agent / RAG · React · FastAPI

highlights.en: Independently built an enterprise RAG knowledge base: document parsing → embedding → retrieval → answer (BGE-M3 + Qdrant + Qwen), split into three services and deployed with Docker Compose.
highlights.zh: 独立搭建企业级 RAG 知识库：文档解析 → 向量化 → 检索 → 问答（BGE-M3 + Qdrant + Qwen），三服务拆分 + Docker Compose 部署。

highlights.en: Led a real-time industrial vision system: multi-stream inference with DeepStream + YOLO + TensorRT, 32 concurrent RTSP feeds, two-stage detection plus an alert state machine with evidence-frame output.
highlights.zh: 主导实时工业视觉系统：DeepStream + YOLO + TensorRT 多路视频推理，32 路 RTSP 并发，两阶段检测 + 告警状态机，配套证据帧输出。

highlights.en: Automated PyTorch → ONNX → TensorRT build and deployment plus camera calibration; services containerized on a Linux GPU server (4× NVIDIA L20).
highlights.zh: PyTorch → ONNX → TensorRT 自动构建部署 + 相机标定；服务 Docker 化托管于 Linux GPU 服务器（4× NVIDIA L20）。
